rule.name: if/else bodies must use curly braces
rule.description: From the project style guide: "Always use curly braces for `if` statements, even one-liners." (else-if chains allowed)

parameter.value: Use curly braces for this if/else body (agents/style/conventions.md)

rule.name: line comments are written //comment (no space after //)
rule.description: From the project style guide: "Write line comments as `//comment`, not `// comment`."

parameter.value: Write line comments as //comment, not // comment (agents/style/conventions.md)
